summary: Iteration 47 — DEVICE-TEST FIX PASS. All ten fixes verified on the live preview (reviewer login review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable> @ 390x844) plus the seeded pytest account. BACKEND (pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration47_device_fixes.py — 11/11 in 38.4s): (1) POST /api/shop-check on user_testaura01 returned {verdict, reason, outfits_added, similar_items, matches_with, fills_gap} and for the duplicate arm outfits_added was forced to 0 and already_covered was set to 'You can already create similar looks with the …you own.' (2) POST /api/stylist/chat without thread_id created a thread and returned thread_id; passing that thread_id back appended to the SAME thread (GET /api/stylist/threads/{id} showed the 4 turns in order); the needs_context short-circuit ('what should i wear tonight?') also persisted its turn (msgs=2, assistant text contains '?', reply is Aureve's canned occasion question) and returned thread_id. (3) GET /api/stylist/threads returns newest-first rows WITHOUT message bodies (verified list keys = id/title/summary/recommendations/archived/updated_at and sorted desc on updated_at). POST /api/stylist/threads/{id}/archive set archived:true, kept the messages, and filled title/summary; unknown thread ids return 404 on both GET and archive. (4) After archiving, a NEW conversation asking 'What skirt colour did you recommend before?' produced a substantive reply (no flat 'I have no history' style refusal) — the earlier_threads_line summary is being injected. (5) 'Give me a completely different look — it doesn't have to use anything I own' returns needs_context is not True and the reply is not merely 'what's the occasion?'. (6) POST /api/insights/health-report returns headline/lesson/nudges/wins/missing_piece typed correctly. (7) GET /api/insights month.wears_logged is unchanged by a POST /api/dressme call. Also confirmed with a raw /api/outfits/mix POST that the source outfit_id doesn't create a new outfit and doesn't log a wear: outfits delta 0, wears delta 0. FRONTEND (Playwright at 390x844): STYLIST — /stylist shows both stylist-history (clock) and stylist-clear (pen) icons; sending 'What would you pair with my black silk blouse?' returned a wardrobe-aware reply naming the Black Silk Blouse + real pieces; navigating away to /home and returning restored the same conversation from the server; the pen (stylist-clear) archived and cleared the chat; the clock (stylist-history) opened the journal with exactly one stylist-thread-<id> tile; tapping it reopened the archived conversation with the original messages present. SHOPPING INTELLIGENCE — /shop has 0 gap-refresh, 1 analyse-wardrobe, 1 shop-back; no 'Re-analyse wardrobe' text anywhere. HEALTH REPORT — /health-report: no 3-tile numeric row (none of 'outfits worn', 'pieces in rotation', 'never worn yet' appear anywhere in the DOM), health-most-worn strip renders with wear counts (1× this month), health-unworn strip renders, plus health-style-unworn/health-insight/health-nudges/health-wins/health-next-buy/health-open-shopping all render after the async AI call (~20s). PROFILE — /profile: subscription-card count = 0 (large card gone), how-aureve-works count = 0 (row gone), manage-subscription count = 1 in the ACCOUNT section and contains 'Aureve Premium · Renews …' text for the premium reviewer; sign-out/delete-account/privacy-policy/terms all still present. SAVED OUTFIT DETAIL — /saved renders 2 saved-outfit-* tiles; tapping the first navigates to /outfit/<id>, where outfit-duplicate is absent (0) and outfit-mix-up is present (1); tapping outfit-mix-up navigates to /dressme?mix_outfit=<id> and rendered a fresh 'Office all day, then drinks after work' look with Black Silk Blouse + Beige Chino + White sneakers + Black Tote — while the source outfit's item_ids remain intact server-side and no wear was recorded. REGRESSION — Dress Me generates outfits (Mix Up + fresh looks), tab bar unobstructed in every screenshot at 390x844 (visible Home / Wardrobe / Dress Me / Outfits / Profile), no red-screen errors, only pre-existing harmless RN-Web warnings (shadow* style, props.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3102-3109 — shop-check duplicate rule fires when result['similar_items'] is non-empty AND fills_gap is falsy, OR verdict is 'Skip' (case-insensitive). outfits_added is forced to 0 in either case; already_covered is only appended when it is a duplicate (not when the model returned Skip with no similar_items). This matches the spec 'similar_items non-empty and fills_gap false, or verdict Skip → outfits_added 0'.

server.py:2072-2075 — the needs_context short-circuit now runs persist_stylist_turn BEFORE returning, so the vague question and Aureve's occasion prompt are stored in the same thread (verified GET /stylist/threads/{id} shows both messages). thread_id is returned so the client can continue in the same thread.
server.py:2151-2156 — GET /stylist/threads projects out messages, so the list view stays small; recommendations always coerces to [] when missing. Sort is on updated_at desc.

server.py:2196-2200 — archive updates archived/title/summary/recommendations and refreshes updated_at, but does NOT delete messages — verified GET /{id} after archive still contains the original turns.

server.py:1985-1992 — needs_occasion_context skips when the user has EVER said 'doesn't have to be from my wardrobe / completely different look / style reset'. Verified an unrestricted request does not return needs_context:true.
app/(tabs)/stylist.tsx:180-183 — stylist-history and stylist-clear icons are separate testIDs; loadThreads() runs on history tap so the journal is fresh.

app/outfit/[id].tsx:129-130 — outfit-mix-up pushes /(tabs)/dressme?mix_outfit=<outfit id>; the original outfit is never mutated; app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx:148-150 picks up mix_outfit and calls /api/outfits/mix with {outfit_id}, which returns a suggestion payload — POST /api/wear is never called during mix.
app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:200-217 — manage-subscription is the only subscription row on Profile; there is no subscription-card testID and no 'How Aureve Works' row anywhere.

app/health-report.tsx (whole file) — no three-tile numeric row; testIDs match the spec (health-most-worn / health-no-wears / health-unworn / health-style-unworn / health-insight / health-nudges / health-wins / health-next-buy / health-open-shopping).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every one of the ten device fixes verified at 390x844 (stylist persistence + history/reopen, /shop no Re-analyse button, /health-report no numeric tile row + full AI render, /profile no subscription card & no How Aureve Works & compact manage-subscription with plan+renewal, /outfit/<id> no Duplicate + Mix It Up navigates to /dressme?mix_outfit=<id> and preserves the original + no wear logged, Dress Me regenerates, tab bar clean).

seed_data_creation: The pytest run created a couple of TEST_iter47 stylist threads on user_testaura01 and archived them (they remain in db.stylist_threads for continuity checks, per spec: archive keeps, never deletes). The reviewer account has one live thread with the string 'TEST_iter47 What would you pair with my black silk blouse?' which was archived through the UI test and appears as a single stylist-thread-* row in the journal — harmless, verifies the exact flow. No wear logs and no new outfits were created; the /api/outfits/mix regression showed outfits/wears deltas of 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reviewer login: review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>; press 'Log In' from /welcome, then use login-email / login-password / email-submit. Premium is granted (premium_until=2099-01-01). TestIDs to lean on: stylist-history (clock, opens journal), stylist-clear (pen, archives + starts fresh), stylist-thread-<id> (journal tiles), stylist-input/send/attach/attached; shop-back, analyse-wardrobe on /shop (gap-refresh is intentionally absent); health-most-worn OR health-no-wears, health-unworn, health-style-unworn, health-insight, health-nudges, health-wins, health-next-buy, health-open-shopping on /health-report (three big numeric tiles removed); manage-subscription on /profile (subscription-card and how-aureve-works intentionally absent); outfit-mix-up on /outfit/<id> (outfit-duplicate intentionally absent), navigates to /(tabs)/dressme?mix_outfit=<id> which calls /api/outfits/mix. BACKEND: POST /api/stylist/chat accepts optional thread_id and returns thread_id even for the needs_context short-circuit; GET /api/stylist/threads returns rows without messages sorted newest-first; POST /api/stylist/threads/{id}/archive sets archived:true and fills title/summary. Health-report and month-block wear numbers still come exclusively from db.wear_logs. shop-check forces outfits_added=0 and adds already_covered when similar_items non-empty and fills_gap false (also when verdict is Skip, without necessarily adding already_covered). Pre-existing RN-Web warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) are harmless — ignore.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all ten device-test fixes verified end-to-end. The one initial pytest failure (test_needs_context_short_circuit_persists_turn) was in the test's own assertion — the canned occasion prompt is 'Happy to style you — what are you doing tonight? Tell me the occasion (…) and I'll build the right look.' which ends in a period, not a '?'. Fixed by asserting '?' anywhere in the reply. No code change required.
